title: Neon Coral Lamp
description: A glowing glass orb sits atop a dark vintage lamp base, containing luminous branching coral-like structures in bright white, magenta, and neon yellow-green. Floating organic shapes, bubbles, and swirling light patterns fill the transparent sphere against a dark abstract background.
prompt: A surreal glowing glass sphere mounted on a vintage lamp base, containing luminous branching coral and leafy structures in bright white, magenta and neon yellow-green. Swirling patterns, floating bubbles and organic forms fill the transparent orb, bioluminescent light effects, dark moody background with paint splatters, vibrant yet mysterious atmosphere, painterly digital art style.
